# Reproduces the offensive pattern: drop a payload outside the systemd
# loci, then symlink it from multi-user.target.wants/ so systemctl
# enables it without ever creating a file under /etc/systemd/system/.
/tmp/.cache/poll.service	etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/poll.service
